summary: Specifies how LDP can be extended to set up constraint-based routed label-switched paths, using new TLVs. This lets an operator choose paths by requirements such as bandwidth instead of only the shortest route. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Normal directions give you the shortest road. This lets a network pick a road that also meets rules, like having enough room for a big truck.

questions: how to set up constrained lsps
